title: International Postgraduate Diploma in Health and Social Care Management (Level 7)
description: The qualification aims to develop learners’ understanding of policy, management theory and practice in health and social care.
longDescription: Aim of the Programme: The objective of the International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in Health and Social Care Management qualification is to develop learners’ understanding of policy, management theory and practice in health and social care. It provides learners with an opportunity to engage with the challenges facing professionals, services users and policymakers in their own country. It will provide knowledge that underpins the ability to work as an effective manager in the hospital/social care industry. It combines both theoretical and practical knowledge in the health and social care profession. Programme Structure This program consists of 6 compulsory units, which are equal to a total of 120 credits.
courseDetails: 7 source-listed curriculum sections and 52 lesson or resource entries are included below.
entry: An honours degree in a related subject or the UK level 6 diploma or equivalent overseas qualification, i.e. bachelor's Degree or Higher National Diploma
Mature learners (over 25) with at least five years of management experience if they do not possess the above qualification (this is reviewed on a case-by-case basis)

accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: University Top-up Upon completing this course, students can complete a Master's degree programme from one of our Partner Universities. The top-up programme can be studied online. The top-up may comprise the study of a few modules or a final dissertation project. (The course tuition fee listed above does NOT include the top-up fee) For more details and partner Universities offering the topup, please speak to our student advisors.
workshops: Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.

modules.title: LEADING CHANGE IN HEALTH AND SOCIAL CARE
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to help learners develop an understanding of theories of change management and how they apply to contemporary organisations in the globalised world, with the identification and use of change models. The unit also explores different perspectives affecting health and social care service quality and how this is evaluated in order to empower and involve users of services.

modules.title: MANAGING FINANCE IN THE HEALTH AND SOCIAL CARE SECTOR
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to introduce key financial concepts and tools for managers in health and social care. The unit gives consideration to the knowledge and understanding necessary for making finance informed decisions in health and social care organisations. This unit should be studied within the contexts of local, national and international legal frameworks and good practice relating to finance.

modules.title: MANAGING PEOPLE IN HEALTH AND SOCIAL CARE
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to enable the learner to understand the processes involved in the recruitment, management and development of people in the health and social care workplace. Learners will develop skills in the recruitment and retention of staff, as well as the importance of training and industrial relations. Learners will also understand the importance of identifying and managing cultural diversity in the workforce.

Performance Appraisal and Development in Health and Care - N
Training and Development In Healthcare - N
Managing Diversity In Health and Social Care - N
Managing People in Health and Social Care

outcomes: Analyze Policy Issues: Critically evaluate and analyze the policies and regulations impacting the health and social care sector, considering the perspectives of professionals, service users, and policymakers in their own country.

Apply Management Theory: Apply management theories and principles to effectively manage and lead health and social care organizations, considering the unique challenges and complexities of the industry.

Foster Effective Change: Develop strategies to lead and manage change effectively within health and social care organizations, taking into account the impact on professionals, service users, and stakeholders.

Enhance Performance: Assess and implement strategies to enhance performance and quality improvement in health and social care settings, promoting optimal outcomes for patients, clients, and communities.

Plan and Ensure Accountability: Develop and implement comprehensive plans, including financial, operational, and quality management strategies, while ensuring accountability and compliance with relevant regulations and standards.

Develop and Lead Teams: Cultivate effective team leadership and development skills, fostering a collaborative and supportive work environment to optimize team performance and achieve organizational goals.

Integrate Theoretical and Practical Knowledge: Integrate theoretical concepts with practical knowledge to address real-world challenges and issues in health and social care management, demonstrating the ability to apply acquired knowledge and skills in professional settings.

Pursue Diverse Career Opportunities: Demonstrate the competence to work in various roles within healthcare administration and management, such as healthcare managers, policy analysts, project managers, or consultants.

Exhibit Ethical and Professional Behavior: Exhibit ethical and professional behavior in health and social care management, adhering to relevant codes of conduct and promoting ethical decision-making and integrity in all aspects of practice.
